thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: egress-proxy service is seeing an elevated 5xx spike across multiple regions. Rolling 1m alert. Affected path: /v1/stream -> 5xx rate ~16-22% over last 3m. Flagging oncall. Correlation samples: cid=eg-7f3a, cid=eg-b92c, cid=eg-21d4. Link: https://kibana.company/egress-5xx-1918765432 :rotating_light:
Jen L.: I'm on it — joining. Anyone already looking at traces or the proxy config?
Omar N.: joining. I can pull traces. quick question: customer impact? any dropped websockets or primarily HTTP?
Support Ops: initial customer impact report: ~12 customers with increased 5xx for inference requests, primarily short-lived failures, retries from clients causing higher latency. No large enterprise SLA breaches yet.
Jen L.: thanks. Kyra, can you check routing fanout changes? we pushed a traffic-split yesterday.
Kyra P.: checking config now. I don't see recent changes to routing table since >12h. There was a canary of a new retry-policy yesterday but rolled back.
runtime-sre-bot: Recent deploys: 
- 2026-03-15T02:10Z deploy egress-proxy v3.2.1 (config: retry-policy=adaptive)
- 2026-03-14T22:05Z canary retry-policy v2 -> rolled back at 22:20Z
Jen L.: hypothesis 1: upstream service is returning 5xx under load causing proxy to surface 5xx. hypothesis 2: proxy overload or misconfigured keepalive causing connection resets. hypothesis 3: retry amplification from client and proxy.
Omar N.: pulling sample logs for the cid=eg-7f3a and eg-b92c. Logs look like this:
```json
{
  "ts":"2026-03-15T09:12:07.123Z",
  "service":"egress-proxy",
  "level":"error",
  "msg":"upstream 502 from model-server-04",
  "path":"/v1/stream",
  "cid":"eg-7f3a",
  "latency_ms": 512
}
```
Omar N.: another tail shows connection reset: `upstream connection reset by peer` for cid=eg-b92c.
Jen L.: do we see the same upstream returning 5xx or is it spread?
Omar N.: early look: ~70% of 5xx map to model-server-0[2-5] in us-west-2, others spread across a few nodes.
Kyra P.: I can temporarily reduce fanout to limit concurrent upstream connections. Suggest toggling per-route max_conns from 200 -> 40 as mitigation. That should reduce pressure and stop cascading failures.
Jen L.: good. Also let's disable proxy-side retries to avoid amplification (set retries=0). Can someone patch the proxy config and trigger a rolling restart on egress-proxy-prod? Keep canary tiny (1 pod) then escalate.
Kyra P.: applying change now: `kubectl -n infra set env ds/egress-proxy RETRIES=0 && patch configmap egress-proxy-config --patch '{"data":{"max_conns":"40"}}'` — will roll config.
runtime-sre-bot: Config update submitted by Kyra P. Patch: egress-proxy-config.max_conns=40, RETRIES=0. Rolling restart initiated; expected completion ~2m per AZ.
Jen L.: monitoring error-rate and error-budget spikes. Support Ops please hold customer comms on a 'we're investigating' ack.
Support Ops: acknowledged. Sending a short note to affected customers with correlation sample ids.
Omar N.: after disabling retries, initial drop in downstream 5xx rate from 18% -> 8% in us-west-2 within 90s. Latency stabilized for several traces. Sending timeline snippet:
```
09:12:07Z - first spike alert (5xx ~20%)
09:13:10Z - Kyra begins config patch (retries -> 0)
09:14:30Z - restart completes (az-a)
09:15:40Z - measurable 5xx drop to ~9%
09:16:30Z - restarts complete (all AZs)
09:17:00Z - 5xx baseline ~6-7%
```
Jen L.: good mitigation. next: collect full request logs for 2m window around 09:12Z and push to the RCA channel. Omar, can you export a 2m slice and anonymize tokens?
Omar N.: exporting now: `./tools/export_logs --cid-prefix eg- --start 2026-03-15T09:10:00Z --end 2026-03-15T09:14:00Z --output /tmp/egress-1918765432.log`
Omar N.: uploaded sanitized logs to https://kibana.company/downloads/egress-1918765432.log
Kyra P.: I'll also attach the proxy metrics dashboard and heatmap. initial observation: connection resets spike aligns with CPU on model-server-04 hitting 92% for ~30s.
Jen L.: hypothesis refined: model-server node CPU spike => returns 5xx -> proxy retries before mitigation amplified load -> more 5xx. Root cause likely upstream resource saturation combined with proxy retry policy.
Support Ops: customer impact update: no retries from our side after mitigation; a subset of automated clients may have retried and caused delayed additional inflight requests but overall success improved.
Jen L.: action items: 
- [ ] RCA owner: Omar N. (collect logs, traces, and host metrics)
- [ ] Ops action: Kyra P. (review and harden retry-policy and per-route conn limits; add circuit-breaker)
- [ ] Runtime: schedule capacity guardrails on model-server autoscaler to prevent 90%+ CPU sustained spikes
- [ ] Docs: write short postmortem template and customer timeline (Support Ops)
Jen L.: linking traces for later analysis: https://traces.company/trace/eg-7f3a and https://traces.company/trace/eg-b92c
Omar N.: capturing timeline and initial hypothesis in the RCA doc: https://docs.company/rca/1918765432-egress-fanout (draft). I'll add correlation table: cid -> upstream node -> CPU snapshot.
Kyra P.: follow-up: will add circuit-breaker config: `consecutive_5xx_threshold=5, cooloff=30s` to limit blast radius.
Jen L.: closing on-call handoff: I'll keep monitoring for 30m; if error rate creeps >10% again, escalate to P1 and page runtime-sre escalation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
runtime-sre-bot: Reminder: capture core dumps if nodes show OOM or segfaults — enable `collect_on_error=true` for model-server pods during postmortem window.
Support Ops: posting final customer note in 10m with mitigation summary.
Jen L.: marking thread as 'mitigated' for now; RCA work continues asynchronously. Add any late traces or logs to the doc.
